articles.summary: Most AI transformations fail before they even launch — not because the technology is weak, but because no one asked the right question first. In this episode, Michelle Booth (Zoom) and Andy Kingston (Lloyds Banking Group) break down what actually separates successful AI-driven CX from expensive tech projects that stall.
articles.title: Zoom in on CX: Why Most AI in CX Fails Before It Even Launches
